analysis.reason: RSI가 51.0으로 중립 구간에서 횡보 중. MACD 히스토그램은 개선세를 보이나 여전히 음수 구간. 5일간 변동률은 -2.05%로 하락 마감. 5일 평균 거래량 대비 비율 0.17로 위축된 거래량은 방향성 판단에 신뢰도를 낮춤. 주봉 ADX 12.7로 추세 미형성 구간. 종합적으로 매수/매도 우위를 결정할 만한 명확한 지표 부재로 관망.
analysis.reasonEn: RSI is consolidating in the neutral zone at 51.0. MACD histogram shows improvement but remains negative. The 5-day return was -2.05%, closing lower. The volume ratio of 0.17, below the 5-day average, reduces confidence in directional conviction. Weekly ADX at 12.7 indicates a lack of trend. Overall, a wait-and-see approach is warranted due to the absence of clear indicators for a buy or sell bias.

· 5일/20일 고가·저가 패턴 (5일 고가 $267.56, 5일 저가 $255.02; 20일 고가 $282.79, 20일 저가 $255.02): 5일 고가 < 20일 고가, 5일 저가 > 20일 저가로 횡보 패턴 확인

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price($260.98) vs SMA5($261.00)/SMA20($265.73)/SMA50($251.99): Below SMA5, below SMA20, above SMA50 indicating short-term trend weakening, mid-term trend support confirmed
· Position vs SMA100($254.55)/SMA200($238.74): Mid-to-long-term trend strength maintained
· 52-week Position (71.2%) + Current price range in a pullback phase from historical highs
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (52.5 → 51.0): Neutral zone consolidation, indicating lack of directional bias
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-1.4718 → -1.0768): Improving within negative territory, no confirmation of trend reversal signal
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Middle Band $265.73): Sideways movement near the middle band, band width narrowing to 9.70%
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($255.19): Support zone based on SMA50 and Pivot S1($249.73)
· Swing Resistance ($274.75): Located below Pivot R1($277.50) and 52-week high($287.20)
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (5-day High $267.56, 5-day Low $255.02; 20-day High $282.79, 20-day Low $255.02): Sideways pattern confirmed with 5-day high < 20-day high and 5-day low > 20-day low
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.17): Significantly contracted compared to the 5-day average, reducing confidence in price movement
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Accumulation): No clear directional bias, wait-and-see maintained as entry conditions for buy/sell are not met
